duplicate_environment_pattern.note: Package sizes are observed download sizes from the SCALE-141 runner log; no billing inference is made.

after_policy.integration_spine: CI remains the repository integration gate; x86_64 remains the normal required execution path.
after_policy.arm_portability: ARM64 runs only for dependency, packaging, lock, or portability-sensitive changes.
after_policy.experiment_workflows: D02, SCALE-02, TRAIN-29, and D08 use scientifically scoped pull_request paths and retain workflow_dispatch.
after_policy.milestone150: Runs automatically only for its target branch and ladder-relevant paths; workflow_dispatch remains available.
after_policy.cheap_preflight: Python, Git source identity, lock index/profile and lock-file hashes are validated before expensive tests or dependency installs.
after_policy.concurrency: Superseded pull-request SHA runs cancel within their workflow; manually dispatched historical evidence runs are not grouped for cancellation.

observed_runner_savings_estimate.basis: sum of completed job wall durations on baseline SHA c6e8ac2784920cb96b9b34d26cd68cf9468bd5f0 that the after-policy would not schedule for a representative MILESTONE-150-only PR

migration_rules: Never remove an integration-spine required gate merely to make a branch green.
A path filter is allowed only when the workflow's scientific evidence cannot be affected by changes outside the declared scope.
Expensive experimental campaigns retain workflow_dispatch so historical evidence can be intentionally regenerated.
Concurrency cancellation applies to superseded pull-request SHA runs, not intentionally dispatched historical experiment runs.
Dependency or packaging changes must still fan into portability validation, including ARM64 and D08 purpose environments.
A branch-specific experiment workflow must not trigger solely because an unrelated PR targets an experiment branch.
Cheap source/dependency preflight must precede tests and multi-gigabyte environment installation.

The current full locked-environment verifier remains authoritative; eliminating its internal duplicate clean installs requires a separate evidence-schema migration rather than silently weakening verification.
